title: Cobblemon To The Skies
description: Cobblemon x Create: Aeronautics | All 1025 Pokemon | Mega Evolution | Trainers and Badges | Legendary Pokemon Structures | Shaders | and more!
body:
Combining the two most favorited mods of our time, Cobblemon x Create, and take it to the skies with Create: Aeronautics. Explore the air flying on the back of your Cobblemon, or on the safety of your own blimp! Automate materials, complete your living dex, you can do it all!

# Take on the Gym Challenges
- Craft your trainer card and select a regions gym challenge (Kanto, Sinnoh, or Borrius from Pokemon Unbound)
- Defeat the gym leaders in order to challenge the Elite Four and the Champion in the End!
- Collect their badges in your badge case to become the worlds best trainer

# Catch em All
- With [AllTheMons (Lvnatic)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/allthemons-x-mega-showdown-legacy), you can catch all 1025 pokemon (no fakemon) in survival mode.
- All legendary pokemon will spawn either in the wild, or through their [Legendary Monuments](https://modrinth.com/mod/legendary-monuments) structure!

# Battle Gimmicks
- All battle Gimmicks can be utilized in this modpack using [Cobblemon: Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-mega-showdown)
- All megas from the original games are included, including the ones from ZA and the Mega Dimension DLC.

_Discord and Wiki coming soon_
